summary: Backend testing of v1.1.3 Customer Outstanding bug-fix + new date filter against LIVE Firestore. 6/6 tests passed. Haseena Ceramic outstanding is now POSITIVE (812675) — matches independent recompute (opening 0 + billed 2455975 - payments 1562800 - returns 80500). manual_settled (1412800) is no longer subtracted (previous bug produced negative ~-519625). Rich Ceramic matches (1845575). No negative per-invoice balances. Date filter (date_from/date_to, and date_from-only) correctly filters items, echoes params, and zeroes opening_balance when date_from set. Manual settle/unsettle regression confirms outstanding is UNCHANGED after settle (net-zero after unsettle, both restored cleanly).

minor.issue: Review-request 'expected ~893175' for Haseena ignored returns of 80500; actual expected and returned = 812675. Not a bug — request note used billed-payments only. Confirming here for the record.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_v1_1_3_customer_outstanding.py covers Haseena+Rich outstanding correctness, no-negative-balance, date filter (from+to, from only), and settle/unsettle regression. All PASS against live Firestore. Independent recompute helper uses /api/invoices?customer_id, /api/payments, /api/returns.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous formula subtracted BOTH manual_settled and payments causing double-count when a bill was manually marked settled AND had a real payment. Fixed by removing manual_settled from the subtraction (payments are source of truth); manual_settled remains only as a per-invoice display marker. Confirmed by Haseena numbers turning from -519625 (billed - payments - manual_settled - returns) to +812675 (billed - payments - returns).
